title: Dolphin holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='dolphinGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fd8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a9fd6'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bellyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e6f7ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b8e2f2'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='heartGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b9d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0245e'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Dolphin body: curved arched body -->
  <path d='M18 78 C 20 58, 30 40, 50 34 C 66 29, 78 34, 84 44 C 88 52, 86 62, 78 68 C 70 74, 58 72, 50 66 C 44 61, 40 54, 42 46'
        fill='url(#dolphinGrad)' stroke='none'/>

  <!-- Belly lighter shade -->
  <path d='M28 74 C 32 60, 42 46, 56 42 C 64 40, 70 44, 72 50 C 62 52, 52 58, 46 66 C 40 72, 34 76, 28 74 Z'
        fill='url(#bellyGrad)' stroke='none'/>

  <!-- Dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M52 36 C 50 24, 56 16, 64 18 C 62 26, 60 32, 58 38 Z'
        fill='#59c2ee' stroke='none'/>

  <!-- Tail fluke -->
  <path d='M18 78 C 10 74, 4 76, 2 82 C 8 84, 14 84, 20 82 Z'
        fill='#59c2ee' stroke='none'/>
  <path d='M18 78 C 12 84, 8 90, 10 96 C 16 92, 20 88, 22 84 Z'
        fill='#59c2ee' stroke='none'/>

  <!-- Pectoral fin (left, near viewer) -->
  <path d='M44 62 C 38 66, 34 74, 38 78 C 44 76, 48 70, 50 64 Z'
        fill='#2f8fc4' stroke='none'/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='44' r='3.2' fill='#123a52'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='43' r='1.1' fill='#e6f7ff'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M72 52 C 76 55, 82 55, 85 51' fill='none' stroke='#123a52' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Right flipper reaching up to hold heart -->
  <path d='M60 58 C 66 54, 70 46, 68 40 C 72 44, 74 52, 70 60 C 66 62, 62 61, 60 58 Z'
        fill='#2f8fc4' stroke='none'/>

  <!-- Heart held above -->
  <path d='M66 30 C 60 24, 52 24, 52 31 C 52 37, 60 41, 66 46 C 72 41, 80 37, 80 31 C 80 24, 72 24, 66 30 Z'
        fill='url(#heartGrad)' stroke='none'/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <path d='M58 29 C 56 27, 56 31, 58 33' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3cf' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
